PrivacyPolicyContent:
Welcome to the ArchTech app, a specialized application in the field of archaeology. We value your trust and are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect the personal information you provide when using the app.

1. Information We Collect:

Account Information: To create an account in ArchTech, we may ask you to provide personal information such as your name, email address, and password.
Interaction Data: We collect information about how you use the app, including places you visit and content you view.
Location Data: We may collect precise geographic location data to provide detailed information about nearby archaeological sites.

2. How We Use the Information:

We use the collected information to provide and improve our services, including:

- Offering personalized content tailored to your interests.
- Responding to your inquiries and technical support requests.
- Sending app updates and important notifications.

3. Sharing Information:

We are committed to not selling or renting your personal information to third parties. We may share information only in the following cases:

- With service providers working on our behalf, such as cloud service providers.
- To comply with legal obligations or to protect the rights and safety of ArchTech and its users.

4. Information Security:

We use advanced security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access and disclosure. However, absolute security on the internet cannot be guaranteed.

5. Your Rights:

You have the right to access, correct, or request the deletion of your personal information. You can update your personal information through your account settings in the app.

6. Changes to the Privacy Policy:

We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify you of any significant changes through the app or your email.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us at [Support Email].

Thank you for using ArchTech.
